notes.title: Update - Game controller auto-select option
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New Game controller auto-select option. When ON, the game controller will be automatically linked to joystick. The option is set ON by default. User is still responsible for attaching the joystick cable though.
[*] Fix: sending correct device id for emulator failed sometimes when attaching joystick. (Especially when more than one Game controllers where attached)
[*] Small performance fix for Direct Input device handling
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Cassette tape animation
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Cassette tape animates on play/rew/ffwd/rec.
[*] The cassette stops when it has been wound to the end.
[*] The cassette now defaults to the beginning when it's ejected or out of the deck.
  (A technical limitation. The state has to be in sync with the emulator)
[*] Pet cabel artifact fix.
[*] Disabled rest of the simulator view mouse hover sounds.
[*] Fix to restrict simulator view zoom actions while menu is open.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Tape drive counter adjustments
notes.notes:
[list]

[*] Fix for counter speed drop down after reset.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Cassette unit feature updates
notes.notes:
Cassette unit feature updates.
[list]
[*] VIC-20 C2N cassette recorder got a working counter.
[*] It's now possible to rewind the tape to the beginning.
[*] Updates to counter and counter reset logic.
[*] Record multiple programs after another on the cassette.
[*] Load programs from different locations on the cassette.
[/list]

Note! In case someone loves the tape handling too much, you may notice some funny/missing features.
[list]
[*] The actual tape inside the cassette still lacks the corresponding state/animation.
[*] Cassette can be fast forwarded to infinity.
[*] Computer reboot or cassette switch will reset the tape to the beginning.
[/list]

Added Norwegian and Danish to keyboard layout selection.
